authority: User explicitly approved further justified experiments and main publication; parent orchestrator owns Git and launch.

methods.NO_F_LINEAR: Fresh original P/E/D plus channel-shared Linear(512,48,bias=True) instead of F; all jointly trained. Head initialized to latent persistence, adds 24624 parameters; zero foundation construction/calls.
methods.NO_F_LINEAR_NO_P: Same fresh original B2 initialization, then replace P by Identity; retain initialized E/D and add the identical trainable shared Linear512-to48. With existing Full-P/No-P Bolt and new Full-P Linear, forms an exploratory 2x2 with disclosed cap schedules.
methods.NO_ANCHOR: Remove only the explicit x_last output addition. Keep P/E/frozen F/lag7 D, latent differencing, original PCA initialization, and no new decoder bias.
methods.A5_LAG0: Keep x_last anchor and only lag0 decoder (future-z_last)D0, removing lag1/2/4/8/16/32 coefficients.

initialization: Construct original full B2 at each original seed and stage. Common P/E/D tensors are unchanged before the registered intervention. NO_F head is added only after P/E/D initialization.

training.selection: Minimum A_stop MSE, earlier exact tie, sealed before fresh A60 refit and V evaluation.

data_bounds.chronology: A_fit 0-50%; A_stop 50-60%; fresh A60 refit; V70-80%; bounded loaders exclude protected T80-100%.

extension_policy.trigger: At least 3/5 base seeds select cap3
extension_policy.terminal: At least 3/5 cap10 selections imply UNDERTRAINED_AT_10; no further extension.
extension_policy.action: Whole five-seed family cap10 only if time admission fits; no partial family is primary.
extension_policy.order: Required base20, required family extensions, optional A5_LAG0 ETTh1 plus its extension, optional NO_ANCHOR Appliances plus its extension.
extension_policy.decision_data: A_stop selected epochs and wall time only; no V score controls execution.

controller_policy.no_F_reestimate: max completed same-method/same-dataset base wall time *1.35; cap10 multiplier10/3; floor60s
controller_policy.admission: Whole family five seeds before any family admission; worker hard deadline17:30KST.
controller_policy.retry: Technical same-configuration failure only; verified completed jobs reused, scientific failures stop.

analysis.interaction: Per matched Jena seed: (NO_F_LINEAR_NO_P - NO_F_LINEAR) - (A1 - OURS) in V MSE; report all differences and their median. Descriptive schedule-conditional interaction, not a causal interaction test.
analysis.comparator: Reuse Full-P same dataset first five seeds; no new Full baseline needed (all cap3 counts0/5). Reuse Jena No-P cap10 first5; original cap3 selections5/5, extended cap10 selections0/5.
analysis.decision: Descriptive median gap versus maximum IQR, unchanged from preceding campaign; not significance or equivalence.
limits: Exploratory development V repeatedly viewed; no independent T claim.
n=5 is a time-limited pilot and does not establish equivalence.
F comparison jointly retrains P/E/D; replacement has extra24624 trainable parameters.
Jena 2x2 reveals a descriptive interaction only; historical Full-P cap3 and No-P cap10 schedules are disclosed and not a fully balanced compute control.
No-anchor retains latent differences and no new bias; an optimization/parameterization intervention, not universal necessity of a direct path.
A5 tests decoder lag removal only, not an input temporal-branch claim.
Budget-excluded or cap-limited comparisons stay explicitly incomplete/provisional.
